Keeping in mind that maximum chassis what we can be dealing with will be below 50, unordered_map will be in-efficient and will add more overhead of look up and hashing cost?

How do we know that the maximum chassis will be below 50?

Assuming number of chassis will be less than 50, and assuming all chassis numbers are continuous, I think we can use a compile time fixed size array: 

`constexpr auto l_maxNumChassis{50};`
`std::array<nlohmann::json, l_maxNumChassis > m_chassisJsonArray`



We can then use the chassis suffix number from the chassis ID string "chassisN", and use N as an index to the respective JSON entry in the array.

Advantage:
1. Fixed memory allocated at compile time, no compile time memory allocation operations.
2. O(1) modification of chassis JSON entry
3. O(1) look up of chassis JSON entry.
